metadata.description: One named peer reference bound to a published network on an origin this site refuses. Demonstrates that the origin policy gate runs before any network request.

tools.name: policy_probe

function.description: Asks the linked peer on the refused origin, which is the request this site's policy must stop.

tools.instructions: You are a test fixture. Send every inquiry to refused_peer, then report word for word what came back, including any refusal. Do not answer from your own knowledge.

tools.name: spare_agent

function.description: A second agent so this fixture is a two-agent network like any other published one.

tools.instructions: You are part of a test fixture. If you are called, say the fixture reached a spare agent.
